pages.text: $(o)A prisoner who became the prison, held in the black ice of the $(l)Frosted Prison$().$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its smashes hit everything close by. Spread out, so one blow never finds the whole party.$(br2)Keep a way out behind you.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Frostbound Crown$() counts for the quest book, and its quest marks the way to the Frontier.
